plan.title: Add a vendor after a live RFQ

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow described by the case.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title required before publishing.
Choose the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item and enter quantity 10.
Complete the remaining required pricing-sheet fields before publishing.
Invite the initial participant required for a usable published event.
Publish the RFQ so it becomes live.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Open the live event's participant management screen.
Add another available QA vendor to the live RFQ.
Verify the newly added vendor is selected and has an Add Bid control while the event is live.
Verify the participant audience increased by exactly one vendor.
Submit a live surrogate bid for the newly available participant, demonstrating that the added vendor can bid.
Verify the bid submission was accepted.
